top_signals.title: Citadel Securities’ Fed Rate Hike Call Adds to Market Angst
top_signals.summary: On the eve of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision, bond traders are on edge. While most expect policymakers to leave interest rates unchanged, prominent voices across Wall Street are putting their weight behind a hike in just the second meeting run by new Chairman Kevin Warsh.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ethereum L2 ecosystem loses momentum as TVL drops to 2-year low
top_signals.summary: Total value locked in Ethereum Layer 2s has slid back to roughly $5 billion, a level last seen in 2023.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Nansen CEO bets on AI agents to overtake human traders within 2 years
top_signals.summary: Nansen CEO Alex Svanevik says AI agents will overtake human traders in two years as the platform pivots from analytics to agentic trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
